title: French Visiting Translator Fellowship (Trinity Centre for Literary and Cultural Translation)
description: An eight-week literary translation fellowship in Dublin, Ireland, jointly run by Trinity College Dublin's Centre for Literary and Cultural Translation and the French Embassy in Ireland, for practising literary translators currently working on a translation of a work of literature by an Irish or British author into French. The 2027 fellowship runs in February and March 2027. Fellows receive campus accommodation at Trinity College Dublin, a contribution toward living expenses and travel costs (the exact amounts are not published on the public call for applications), and a dedicated workspace at the Centre, plus library access and contact with Trinity academic staff. Open to practising literary translators of any nationality; no enrollment at Trinity or any other institution is required.
org: Trinity Centre for Literary and Cultural Translation (Trinity College Dublin) / French Embassy in Ireland
visaNote: This is a short-term research/translation fellowship, not employment; non-EU/EEA fellows should confirm Ireland's short-stay visa requirements ahead of the residency.
